item: The ruff ratchet fails closed when ruff is not runnable instead of reporting zero findings
summary: A missing ruff module in the interpreter that runs the script exits 1 with empty stdout, which the or-[] fallback read as a clean tree: it printed 0 findings with version unknown and told the developer to lower the ceiling to 0, and scripts/guards_for_diff.py ran it as a blocking gate that measured nothing. Empty output and a non-list are now errors naming the cause, and a version of unknown exits 2 before anything is counted. Ruff's own literal empty list is still a clean tree. Two new tests (output empty or not a list; unrunnable ruff never says lowered) plus the existing verdict tests no longer depend on the installed ruff. CI is unaffected (it installs ruff into the interpreter that runs the ratchet).
